Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 5
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly identified Tai Si as the paternal grandmother of King Kang of Zhou by conflating generations. Tai Si was the wife of King Wen and mother of King Wu (thus grandmother of King Cheng), not the mother of King Cheng. King Kang’s paternal grandmother is King Cheng’s mother, Yi Jiang (wife of King Wu). This misidentification at step 5 led toward the wrong solution.
